notes: Final formatting and placing the degree conversion in a const context produced a byte-identical release benchmark binary. Timed and final source hashes are retained; the const context also prevents runtime constant splitting in unoptimized builds.

An initial full-harness run used an existing executable that did not match the frozen recorded native baseline. That run was discarded and is not included in these timing results. The replacement baseline matches cached-cubic-borrow-fix.json exactly.
No accuracy budgets were loosened. The exact selected-face invariant catches the Rec.2020 gamma-amplified residual without adding a general encoded budget for sRGB or Rec.2020.

Native and portable assembly checks cover all six f32 target/mode wrappers and reachable local helpers, and reject double arithmetic, conversion instructions, fma/fmaf calls. The standard f32 trigonometric/power library implementations are outside this assembly audit.
No new JavaScript changes in this review follow-up. Historical milestone and cached-cubic reports remain unchanged.
